newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER RISES.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER RISES.

text.p: Turnover rose to 1.599 million denars at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian stock exchange from 50,850 denars on Thursday as two companies traded, the exchange said.
Oteks Ohrid sold 30 shares at 150 denars, unchanged from the previous close and below par of 1,941 denars.
A total of 1,644 shares of Alkaloid Skopje traded at 970 denars, flat from Thursday's close and below par of 2,425 denars.
Traded volume was 10 shares at the previous session on Thursday.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
